summary: Fresh-import verification of PJOK Super-App. Backend: 39/39 pytest pass (36 first run + 3 transient Cloudflare 502s on parallel long LLM calls passed on sequential retry). Frontend: all critical flows pass on mobile viewport — Beranda 7-module grid + 4 tabs, Katrol linear scaling (math verified 40->75, 85->100) saved to Arsip, Kelas create + Presensi H/S/I/A/K3 with K3 safety warning modal + recap %HADIR, Profil save+persist, AI Modul Ajar generation via UI (Kop Surat rendered in viewer), Export PDF/docx/xlsx (web opens export URL in new tab; verified 200 + valid file bytes). No deprecated expo packages. No mocked APIs — real claude-sonnet-5-5 calls work.

minor.issue: Transient Cloudflare 502 Bad Gateway when 3+ LLM generations run in parallel (pytest -n2). Sequential retry all passed. Likely preview-proxy timeout on long requests; consider note for production deploy.

ui_bugs.issue: On 375x667 viewport the 'Simpan Kelas' button sits below the fold after filling the multiline siswa field; user must scroll the modal sheet to reach it. Consider keeping footer visible/sticky.
Race condition: if user types before GET /api/profile resolves, useEffect [data] overwrites user input with server values. Save then persists stale data.

issues: Table wider than 375px viewport; %HADIR column clipped (horizontally scrollable but showsHorizontalScrollIndicator=false gives no visual cue)

action_items: Optional: sticky footer for Kelas create modal so save button is always reachable on small screens
Optional: guard Profil form against overwriting in-progress edits when profile query resolves
Optional: enable horizontal scroll indicator (or column compression) on Rekap table for narrow screens
critical_code_review_comments: No deprecated expo packages (expo-av/barcode-scanner/background-fetch absent); Expo SDK 57 / RN 0.86
Backend properly excludes MongoDB _id via _serialize/to_mongo; soft-delete consistent across collections
LLM calls serialized with asyncio.Semaphore(1) — matches Emergent key concurrency limit
Web export path (window.open new tab) works; Playwright expect_download/expect_popup do not catch it — test artifact only, not a bug

success_rate.backend: 100% (39/39 after retry; 92% first run due to 3 transient 502s)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST UI Kelas 8B (3 students) + 1 attendance session + Katrol archive + AI Modul Ajar archive via UI; all TEST-prefixed classes/archives soft-deleted after testing. Profile singleton left as test values (TEST Guru UI 2 / SMPN TEST LOGO).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Import verified working end-to-end. Use pytest with -n0 or low parallelism for LLM tests to avoid Cloudflare 502s on the preview proxy. Web exports open a new tab via window.open (no download/popup event in Playwright; instrument window.open instead). Profile form has a fill-before-load race; wait for input to have a value before filling in tests.
rca_of_issue: 3 initial pytest failures (generate kktp/rubrik, logo-embedded export) were Cloudflare '502 Bad gateway' HTML responses from the preview proxy during parallel long-running LLM requests, not application errors — all 3 passed on sequential retry (134s). No code change needed.
